### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

### Motivation & Academic Context
Explain how this feature relates to Data Structures and Algorithms or Financial Forensic Investigation (e.g. Strongly Connected Components via Tarjan's algorithm, Minimum Spanning Tree, flow networks).

### Proposed Implementation
- **C++ Engine:** Data structures, complexity analysis, and header/source additions.
- **Backend Bridge:** Endpoint contracts and JSON schema.
- **Frontend UI:** Visualization and user controls.

### Additional Alternatives Considered
Any alternative approaches or libraries evaluated.
